tasks.title: Implement feature, label, training, component, and source manifests
acceptance: Keep feature evidence, future outcome evidence, and combined training provenance in separate immutable manifests.
Reject feature manifests containing observations available after knowledge_as_of or prediction_origin_time.
Implement content-addressed site-context components and deterministic manifest identity.
Provide replay and checksum tests for component reuse and incremental rebuild.
verification: uv run ruff check modules/market_intelligence/data_products/manifests.py packages/schemas/emgi/manifests tests/contract/test_emgi_manifests.py

tasks.title: Enforce single-writer relation ownership and split multi-grain model-ready views
acceptance: Register every EMGI/model relation with one grain, one purpose, and one authoritative writer.
Split current-candidate scoring features from historical opened-store training outcomes.
Block dbt and installer SQL from creating the same relation.
Provide migration aliases only when version-pinned and read-only.

tasks.title: Implement decision readiness and abstention contracts
acceptance: Implement DISCOVERY_READY, SCREENING_READY, COMPARISON_READY, DUE_DILIGENCE_READY, and MODEL_TRAINING_READY.
Return explicit unmet requirements and domain reasons instead of a single blended quality score.
Allow model score availability while decision readiness remains blocked.
Add table-driven tests for every readiness transition and contradiction.
verification: uv run ruff check modules/market_intelligence/domain/readiness.py packages/schemas/emgi/readiness tests/contract/test_emgi_readiness.py

tasks.title: Implement entity-partition coverage and valid negative evidence
acceptance: Prove coverage at dataset, scope, tenant, entity, business-date, geometry, and time-window levels.
Do not infer tenant/store/date completeness from a platform ingestion run alone.
Allow numeric zero only when expected entity universe, source partition, reconciliation, source health, and completeness are all valid.
Expose saturation, truncation, source error, and unknown coverage independently.
